verdict.rationale: The Dropbox Files API and official SDKs support scripted file actions such as creating, moving, and deleting, plus folder listing, so a user can loop over many items programmatically. There are also thin hints of scale-oriented workflows: listing all team-accessible namespaces and performant file uploads. However, nothing in the evidence documents true batch or bulk endpoints, so bulk work appears to mean scripting per-item calls. Missing for 10: explicit batch operation endpoints (e.g. batch move/copy/delete/upload), documentation of bulk job status and limits, bulk actions in the UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
